name: aoe3de-unit-body-1024
applies_to: an Age of Empires III DE human unit (rider or infantry) whose body, and any weapon skinned into the body mesh, share one 1024 page; t/m numbers assume 1 engine unit = 1 m
derived_from: vanilla AoE3 DE unit benchmark of 2026-10-11 (references/organic-uv-reference.md): iron_rider_0 body measured with uv_eval on its own page, and the DE 1024 bodies keshik_rider_rank01, yabusamerider_0, musketeer_2age, changdao_0, ashigaru_0age. Hard limits sit at or just past the vanilla value; targets are what the H1 recipe reached on a 1.1k-triangle rider

runs.page: uv_eval on every mesh of the page (body + skinned weapon), the attachment meshes as occluders
runs.body: uv_eval on the body alone (weapon and attachments as occluders): the fair comparison with a vanilla body that owns its page

checks.label: Self-overlap (fold) px2
checks.evidence: 0 on every DE body; SLIM no_flip still left a 4.5 px2 strip fold once

checks.label: Mirrored islands
checks.evidence: DE riders mirror 0 % of their UV

checks.label: Stacked mirror texels px2
checks.evidence: DE bodies give every side its own texels (asymmetric paint, player colour)

checks.label: Min island gap px
checks.evidence: iron_rider_0 21.3 px (gutters vanish at mip 5); DE 4.4-21 px

checks.label: L2 stretch (page)
checks.evidence: iron_rider_0 1.052; a head priority raises the page L2 by design

checks.label: Visible-weighted density p10 t/m
checks.evidence: iron_rider_0 313.4 (uv_eval run VAN_iron_rider_0_body: seated idle oprichnik_idle1 k0 on horse_idle_a k0, pitch 47, 8 headings), reproduced exactly by gr2_lint's visibility port; keshik_rider_rank01 332.2 (sword_idle_A k0 on horse_idle_A k0). Hard min = floor of the lowest vanilla reference, 313: the earlier 314 rounded 313.4 up and failed the reference itself (review finding 2026-10-11, resolved by measurement)

checks.label: GPU vertices, every UV layer in file
checks.evidence: the unit model contract ceiling of 1,050 vertices; vanilla welded 628-1061; UV splits only, normal and material splits not counted

checks.label: Body tiny islands
checks.evidence: uv_eval tiny = under 16 x 16 texels; the benchmark counted iron_rider_0 with 2 islands of 4 triangles or fewer

checks.label: Head/torso density (bone regions)
checks.evidence: owner 2026-10-11 agreed a head priority of about 1.3x like vanilla; iron_rider_0 1.30, changdao 1.22, ashigaru 1.37, keshik 1.47, yabusame 0.97, musketeer 1.02 (same estimator, all faces)

checks.label: Head/torso, visible faces only
checks.evidence: information: the same estimator without never-visible faces; which variant carries the 1.3 target is an open owner decision (references/open-questions.md)
